note: Missing required `namespace` — an SSHSIG signature is bound to its namespace, and a custodian that defaulted one would be choosing what the signature means on the producer's behalf.
A `payload` member carrying raw bytes to sign — the generic oracle's shape. `additionalProperties: false` is what keeps this task from becoming keys/sign under another name.
An algorithm SSHSIG defines no custodian signature for here (ML-DSA). The enum is narrower than the keys family's SignAlgorithm on purpose.
A hash algorithm SSHSIG does not allow (sha1). The spelling is SSHSIG's own and the set is closed.
Empty namespace — PROTOCOL.sshsig forbids it, and an empty namespace would bind the signature to nothing.
Namespace containing a space — printable ASCII without spaces only.
messageHash in standard base64 with padding rather than base64url without — the pattern refuses `+`, `/` and `=`.
messageHash too short to be any allowed digest (fewer than 43 characters).
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 producer rule.
Response without `signature` — the one member the task exists to return.
Response smuggling key material beside the signature — additionalProperties: false on the response is what makes 'never the private key' checkable.
